judgment.summary: Lean risk-off with a strong tape. The Fed is hiking into a hot economy and an oil shock, and the long end has broken out (10y 5.11%, 30y 5.40%, real 2.76%, MOVE about 105). Stocks and bonds are falling together, so cash, not duration, is the hedge. Credit and equity vol have not confirmed stress: HY 273bp, VIX 15.7. The index sits 1% from its high on +29% earnings growth, but leadership is narrow: Mag 7 is +19pp vs equal weight over 3 months, while small caps, housing and rate-sensitive groups break down. The book should run 60% gross with long-duration growth capped at 15%. Own earnings momentum that funds itself (Mag 7 led by META, cybersecurity, selected software), hold energy as the oil-shock hedge, and keep dry powder for the refunding and FOMC window (28 October to 4 November). The crowd's error is the neoclouds and AI infrastructure financing trade: the allowlist is 9/0 long while the basket lags by 16pp. Its opportunity is memory, where attention and price are turning up together into Micron's 30 September print.
top_calls: Cybersecurity (CRWD, OKTA, NET, ZS): Overweight. Accelerating with 100% breadth; recurring FCF offsets the rates headwind. Invalidated by the basket losing its 50d, or the 10y above 5.5%
Magnificent 7: Accumulate, concentrated in META and NVDA. Earnings carry the index. Invalidated by breadth inside the Mag 7 falling below 50%, or hyperscaler capex guidance cuts
Energy (XOM, CVX, COP): Overweight as the oil-shock hedge. Invalidated by an Iran ceasefire road map that reopens Hormuz
Memory (MU, SNDK): Accumulate on confirmation after the 30 September print. Pricing +30-40% for Q1 2027 is the thesis; a guide below $50bn invalidates it
Neoclouds, nuclear, space, quantum: Avoid or underweight. Long-duration names with financing needs in a 2.8% real-yield world; revisit when the 10y is below 4.75%
Homebuilders and regional banks: Avoid until the mortgage spread and MOVE fall together
Hedge: index put spreads (equity vol is cheap against bond vol) plus T-bills; not long Treasuries
